products.name: Pink Elegance Rose Bouquet
products.description: Creamy white roses with small white daisy-like flowers, golden-yellow fillers, and green foliage. Features vibrant hot-pink layered wrapping, natural brown burlap, and pink satin ribbons. Large, upright, fan-shaped bouquet arrangement.

products.name: Crimson Rose & Pink Lily Bouquet
products.description: Five deep red roses, one blooming pink lily with green lily buds, delicate white daisy-like flowers, golden-yellow fillers, and fresh green foliage. Features elegant white wrapping with black and bronze borders, natural brown burlap, and a red satin ribbon. Large, upright, fan-shaped arrangement.

products.name: Vibrant Blossom Mixed Bouquet
products.description: Two creamy white roses, two red roses, one pink gerbera daisy, one red gerbera daisy, and one yellow sunflower, accented with small white daisy-like flowers, golden-yellow fillers, and green foliage. Features vibrant hot-pink layered wrapping with natural brown burlap. Large, upright, fan-shaped arrangement.

products.name: Lavender Sunshine Sunflower Bouquet
products.description: Three vibrant yellow sunflowers, pink-and-white alstroemeria flowers, delicate white daisy-like blooms, golden-yellow fillers, and green foliage. Features soft lavender layered wrapping, natural brown burlap, and a deep purple satin ribbon. Large, upright, fan-shaped arrangement.
